// CASE swift_top_let_vs_stored_property expect=pass
let width = 1
struct Importer {
  let width: Int
  func run(_ items: [Int]) async throws {
    try await mapWithConcurrency(items, width, save)
  }
}
// CASE swift_top_let_vs_var_property expect=pass
let limit = 1
final class Exporter {
  var limit = 4
  func run(_ items: [Int]) async throws {
    try await mapWithConcurrency(items, limit, save)
  }
}
// CASE swift_top_let_vs_computed_property expect=pass
let concurrency = 1
struct Pool {
  var concurrency: Int { 4 }
  func run(_ items: [Int]) async throws {
    try await mapWithConcurrency(items, concurrency, save)
  }
}
// CASE swift_top_let_vs_labeled_property expect=pass
let width2 = 1
struct Labeled {
  let width2: Int
  func run(_ items: [Int]) async throws {
    try await mapWithConcurrency(items: items, width: width2, operation: save)
  }
}
// CASE end expect=pass
